This is the third report with the same empty list, so the cause may be the threshold, not a broken report: 73/100 can come from several checks that each scored partway but none low enough to count as "failed or scored low". If so, the list is empty because nothing crossed that line. I've left `index.html` unchanged.

To raise the 73, I'd need the per-check scores. Any check below full marks is something I can work on, even if it isn't flagged.

If you'd rather not dig those out, I can do a general polish pass instead. I'd check accessibility (contrast, focus states, labels) and tighten the copy. That would be a guess at what your rubric rewards and would touch more of the page than you've asked for, so I'll wait for you to say go.
